item.title: Eastern DR Congo: the situation
item.description:
M23 rebels have seized a major town in eastern DRC, breaching a ceasefire and intensifying fighting with the Congolese army. ADF gunmen continue killing civilians in Ituri province amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The Francophonie summit saw a dispute between DR Congo and Rwanda over leadership, prompting a postponement of the vote. Five European states have agreed to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda, establishing a migrant return hub there. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
